verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is a terminal coding agent backed by a paid cloud service, so a published machine-readable API spec is a fair thing to ask of it. However, probes of every standard OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and the docs describe no public API or spec. JSON Lines streaming, JSON Schema-constrained output and llms.txt are machine-readable CLI and docs surfaces, not an API specification, so they don't satisfy this story.
